features.stageIndex: Zero-based position in the eight-stage workflow.
features.technicianWorkload: Assigned jobs still open at prediction time.
features.historicalStageDurationMinutes: Mean of completed historical stages before the prediction.
features.elapsedMinutes: Server-authoritative effective elapsed time excluding approved pauses.
features.progress: Most recent technician-reported progress fraction; never inferred from the outcome.
features.previousDelays: Earlier completed stages with a recorded delay, known before this snapshot.

prediction.target: Eventual effective stage duration greater than 30 minutes
prediction.limitation: Entirely synthetic data. No real-world predictive performance is established. Runtime is machine-specific.
